variable.name: GA4 Measurement ID
variable.notes: Set this to the repo's NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_ID value (currently G-7W2C85629N). GTM cannot read the Next.js env var, so this Constant is the single place the tags read the Measurement ID from.

tag.name: Google tag - GA4
tag.notes: GA4 config. send_page_view is off because page_view is emitted from application code (PageViewTracker). Fires on Initialization and again on set_user_properties so the six user properties refresh once game state is known.
